text:
Alex M.: quick sync — changelog cutoff is EOD Thu 2026-04-02. we need final owners + blockers for SDKs, docs, quickstarts, and sample apps. plz reply with yes/no and any deps.

Jamie L.: sending ownership matrix in a sec. do we want a release note for the new batching config change? :thinking_face:

Monica R.: I'm OK to take sample-app android. I'll need the new embeddings API stable flag added to the quickstart before Thurs.

samir: I can own node/python SDK release notes and the changelog entry. pinged @eng-runtime to confirm the kernel change isn't breaking anything.

Alex M.: thanks. sampler for deps:
- SDKs: need codegen PR merged (PR 4821) + runtime client patch
- Docs: new batching docs + example request/response (Doc PR 507)
- Quickstarts: add env var example for REDWOOD_CACHE_DIR
- Sample apps: android + react-web need updated package pins

devex-bot: Reminder: changelog_cutoff set for 2026-04-02T23:59:00Z. 5 open checklist items.

Jamie L.: status: codegen PR 4821 -> awaiting final CR from @monica; tests flaky on CI-3, retrying. docs PR 507 -> in review (2/2). quickstart env var patch -> open, assigned to @jamie.

Monica R.: I'm on PR 4821 review now. small comment about generated types for streaming responses. will push a follow-up today. CI-3 flakes repro'd locally, I'm debugging.

samir: note on runtime client patch — runtime team said the kernel selection change is behind a feature flag and should be safe, but they asked SDKs to tolerate a marginally different chunked stream. I'll add a test to the python SDK for streaming edge-case.

Alex M.: owners we still need: who will validate sample-app e2e across ros and wasm? and who will run a final smoke for quickstarts?

Jamie L.: I can run quickstart smoke on Thu morning (GMT-7). who can do e2e for react-web? @monica?

Monica R.: I can do react-web e2e. for wasm/ros we need infra access — @eng-infra to confirm test runners.

samir: adding checklist items I'll own:
- Add streaming-edge test to python SDK (PR soon)
- Update changelog draft with SDK notes
- Tag SDK releases after CI green

Alex M.: blockers: 1) CI flake on codegen PR 4821 2) docs example still needs sanitized outputs 3) sample-app android package pin conflict with glide lib. if any of these look like they might slip past Thu EOD, call it out now.

Jamie L.: CI flake looks like a timing issue — @eng-infra is rerunning with a different runner. expecting fix by EOD today. docs sanitized outputs -> I'll take this on after the quick doc review.

Monica R.: Android glide pin - I can try a patch but might require bumping min sdk; that could be a bigger change. propose we ship without android if it blocks — mark it as post-cutoff patch.

Alex M.: OK mark android as optional fallback. mainline: node/python SDKs, docs, react-web sample, quickstarts. please update your PR descriptions with the changelog snippet (1-2 lines) and add the tag "changelog-ready".

samir: will do. PR checklist I added: `changelog-snippet`, `owner`, `release-note-label`, `smoke-tested`.

devex-bot: Action required: 3 PRs missing "changelog-snippet" label. Use /changelog-labeler to add.

Jamie L.: I'll handle /changelog-labeler for the docs and quickstart PRs.

Monica R.: pushed small fix to PR 4821 comments, CI retry triggered. starting react-web e2e tomorrow morning.

Alex M.: thanks team. final ask: by Thu 18:00 UTC update the matrix (link: https://docs.internal/redwood/devexp/release-matrix) with your ownership and status flags (green/yellow/red). if red, put short note. I'll compile and post a snapshot to #release-announce at cutoff.

samir: noted.

Jamie L.: noted — will update by 12:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Monica R.: noted.

Alex M.: closing loop — ping me if anything slips, otherwise see you at snapshot. :rocket:
